{{Quote|Xer, unfurl your flags, reveal your fleet.|Queen Hylei Indrexu Cortess, in ''The Pirate Prince''|<ref name="Xim Week: The Despotica">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek03/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part II: The Pirate Prince)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>}}
'''Hylei Indrexu Cortess''', often called just '''Indrexu''', was the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of [[Ranroon]] circa [[25,100 BBY]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

She became a legend in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] for her resistance to [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] conquests. Her forces fought Xim's [[Janissary/Legends|janissaries]] bravely in the fierce [[Battle of Ranroon]] but were eventually defeated.<ref name="Xim Week" />

==Legacy==
The Ihala Spiral was renamed [[Indrexu Spiral]] by Xim in honor of the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], as well the [[Far Indrexu]], the region conquered after Indrexu's defeat,<ref name="Xim Week" /> and the [[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|''Queen of Ranroon'']], Xim's treasure [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="HSR">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref>

No historical figure in the Tion Cluster, not even Xim himself, was as vivid as Indrexu, and no other was more argued about. Some scholars contended she was a literary invention of later dramatists; others believe she existed, but argued about her role in [[Xim's empire]] and her ultimate fate. To some she was a minor figure, a fixture at Xim's court whose name had endured; to others she was the pivot around which the empire turned, her merest glance the spark that lit the fires of the [[Xer's Campaigns|Cronese Wars]], [[Xim's Expansionist Period|Xim's expansion]], and everything thereafter.<ref name="Xim Week" />
